steps: A coefficient changes how many units you have. A subscript changes the substance, so leave subscripts alone.
Count each element on both sides.
Balance metals and other atoms first. Save O and H for last in combustion.
Type the coefficients in order, like 2, 1, 2.
Two H on the right need 2 H2.

similar_problem.hint: One C, then four H, then oxygen last.

problems.why: The same atoms must appear on both sides, and only coefficients change.
hints: Do not change a subscript to force a balance.
